thought: Doctors wanted to amputate his leg as a schoolboy. His family said no - and he became a Paralympic silver medalist.
support: Sachin Sarjerao Khilari developed gangrene from a bicycle accident as a schoolboy, but his family refused the amputation doctors recommended. He went on to become a mechanical engineer and a UPSC exam tutor, competing in javelin before a 2019 shoulder injury forced a switch to shot put. At the Paris 2024 Paralympics, he won silver with a 16.32m throw - an Asian record.
